language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi. My name is Ming. My family owns a tea shop.
One of the things I like to do is organize teapots, because there are different ways to put them on the shelves.
I can put green, red, and yellow teapots on the shelf in different orders.
I can put a green teapot, then yellow, then red. That is one way. Or I can put green, then red, and then yellow.
That is two ways. I can also start with a yellow teapot, then red, then green.
Or yellow, then green, then red. That is four different ways so far.
I could also start with a red teapot, then yellow, then green. And lastly, a red, then green, then yellow.
So there is a total of six different ways to order green, red, and yellow teapots.
Would you please help me in the tea shop today?
One way to collect data is to conduct a survey. A survey is a method of collecting data by asking a group of people some questions.
Data can be put in tables and graphs so it is easier to interpret.
